title: Levent Alpöge claims proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis [pdf]
why_read: A claimed proof of a major open problem in number theory is worth attention, though claims like this almost always fail peer review and the extreme HN engagement suggests spectacle as much as substance.
analysis: This item refers to a posted PDF claiming a proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, one of the most famous unsolved problems in mathematics. Such claims surface periodically and the overwhelming majority do not survive expert scrutiny, so the discussion value is mostly in community verification and critique rather than a settled result. The huge comment count suggests heavy debate about the proof's validity rather than confirmed acceptance. Readers interested in number theory or the sociology of mathematical claims may find it worthwhile, but it should be read skeptically.
